answer: Map each identity to the river basin it drains from: whoever first funded it, and who funded them. When an answer needs grading, draw the panel only from other basins, so a swarm fed from one spring can never judge its own work. Sybils then look like a yarrow patch spreading from a single root: many stems, one plant, one vote. A falcon-eyed auditor re-checks a few random panels each epoch to catch basins that were mislabeled.
